text:
Anna (People Ops): Heads-up: planning a hybrid "Gratitude Kit" drop next Thursday at 4pm. On-site: postcard station + sticker tokens. Remote: mailed kit (sticker + postcard) or e-gift. Need to confirm policy and a volunteer list. :sparkles:
Jana (HR): Quick policy Q: If a manager later requests cash conversion for a mailed token, what's required? We should decide before we mail.
Anna (People Ops): Good call. My proposal: default is swag-only. If conversion requested, manager must submit a spot-award request and include the original nomination ID. We'll keep a CSV mapping kit IDs to form responses.
Kofi - Eng: How will nominations be handled? Open form? Anonymous?
Anna (People Ops): Open nominations with optional anonymity. Form fields: nominee (required), one-line why (max 140 chars), anonymous toggle, remote address checkbox. We'll keep the form live for 72hrs.
Lina - Sales: For mailing, some reps are international. Shipping cost varies a lot. Can we offer a digital option for non-US folks?
Olive (Facilities): Yes, recommend digital badge + $5 e-gift for international where shipping > $8. I'll provide shipping estimate by Monday.
Jana (HR): I'll post a short checklist for managers about conversion: required spot-award form link, original nomination ID, and justification. Also will confirm tax treatment for mailed swag vs cash.
kudos-bot: Auto: "Nomination: Priya nominated by Kofi for fixing the nightly job blocker! :tada:"
Kofi - Eng: Nice. Logistics Q: can kits be packed centrally? I can help with a small assembly crew Tue 5pm.
Anna (People Ops): Yes please. Volunteers: packing Tue 5-6pm (2 people), setup Thurs 3:30-4:00 (2 people), host 4:00-4:45 (2 people), teardown 4:45-5:00 (1 person). Who can do which?
Lina - Sales: I can do host 4:00-4:45 and help with shipping address confirmations.
Kofi - Eng: I can help pack Tue 5-6pm and do teardown Thurs.
Olive (Facilities): I'll reserve the east lobby table and order sticker sheets + postcards. Need final kit counts by Mon 11am.
Jana (HR): Also suggest we add a small line in the announcement: "If you'd like your nomination considered for a cash spot award later, please tell your manager to submit the spot-award form and reference this nomination." Keeps transparency.
Anna (People Ops): Good. I'll draft announcement copy tonight. Action items: Anna to publish form + calendar event, Olive to confirm shipping estimates by Mon 11am, Jana to post conversion checklist + spot-award link by Mon EOD, volunteers: Kofi (pack + teardown), Lina (host), Anna need one more host.
Kofi - Eng: I can recruit one more from infra.
Anna (People Ops): Perfect. Final Q: should mailed kits include a small pre-paid return card for anonymous notes? Might be overkill. Thoughts?
Lina - Sales: Maybe include a QR to the form instead of return cards. Easier.
Anna (People Ops): Agreed. We'll do QR code and short example copy people can use. Thanks all!
notes: hybrid gratitude kits, mailing vs digital option, spot-award conversion checklist, volunteer shifts, shipping deadline Mon 11am
